Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Subject: Intimation of Schedule of Investors’ Meeting / Call under Regulation 30 of the 
Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Company will hold an 
Investor call on Thursday, 5th June, 2025 at 11:00 hrs IST through VC and in-person as detailed in 
the enclosed invite. 
  
The meeting / call will be initiated with a presentation by Dr. Murtaza Khorakiwala, Managing 
Director and will be followed by a Q&A Session in presence of Dr. Habil Khorakiwala, Chairman. 
 
You are requested to take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
For Wockhardt Limited 
 
 
 
Rashmi Mamtura 
Company Secretary
